originalTitle: Review & Preview: The Bond Market’s Warning
summary: Rising bond yields are becoming more and more difficult for Wall Street to ignore. The Nasdaq Composite tumbled 1.1% on Wednesday, while the S&P 500 fell 0.8%. The stock market was following the bond market, and an auction on 5-year Treasury notes that Mizuho’s Daniel O’Regan described as “disastrous.”
